name: Embercrest Highlands
description: Volcanic highlands of active magma rivers, smoking obsidian crags, and roaring forges.

forge.name: The Sacred Smelting Crucible
forge.hint: First blow the draft with the bellows (3), feed the igneous coal (2), then temper in cold flux (1).

lava_path.name: The Molten Crossing
lava_path.hint: The lava will incinerate flesh, but Kaelen's Magic Eye [V] reveals the submerged obsidian stepping stones.

temple_prisms.name: The Sun Refraction Prisms
temple_prisms.hint: Rotate the three igneous focus prisms until the solar rays converge upon the Caldera Sun Gate.

q_cinderfall_welcome.title: The Embers of Cinderfall
q_cinderfall_welcome.description: Speak with Chieftain Varek and High Priestess Pyra in Cinderfall to prove you come in peace.

objectives.text: Report to Chieftain Warmaster Varek at the Village Hall
Consult High Priestess Pyra by the Great Pyre

q_forge_crucible.title: The Smith's Crucible
q_forge_crucible.description: Deliver the raw igneous ore to Forgemaster Kael and solve the forge temperature puzzle to shape the Obsidian Sun Key.

objectives.text: Deliver Igneous Ore to Forgemaster Kael
Smelt the Obsidian Sun Key at the Forge Station

q_beasts_blessing.title: The Beast's Blessing
q_beasts_blessing.description: Journey west to the Lion's Crag and Solar Aerie. Commune with the Sacred Lion and receive a feather from the Sacred Phoenix.

objectives.text: Approach the Sacred Fire Lion at Lion's Crag
Receive the Radiant Phoenix Feather at Solar Aerie

q_molten_crossing.title: The Molten Crossing
q_molten_crossing.description: Morvath warns of the lethal lava river guarding the temple. Use Kaelen's Magic Eye [V] to reveal the hidden obsidian stepping stones.

objectives.text: Traverse the Molten Chasm safely using Eye Vision

q_temple_prisms.title: The Pillars of Ignareth
q_temple_prisms.description: Align the three Pyre Focus Prisms outside the Temple of the Sacred Pyre to unlock the Caldera Sun Gate.

objectives.text: Rotate the 3 Fire Prisms to focus solar light onto the Gate
Insert the Obsidian Sun Key into the Caldera Gate

q_burning_mother.title: The Burning Mother's Verdict
q_burning_mother.description: Confront the goddess Ignareth in the heart of the volcanic caldera and receive the Fire Elemental Stone.

objectives.text: Witness the manifestation of Ignareth in the Caldera
